headline: PDEA Reports ₱98 Million Drug Seizure and 139 Arrests in Weeklong Operations
deck: PDEA said 91 anti-drug operations conducted from July 30 to August 6 resulted in the seizure of illegal drugs valued at ₱98 million and the arrest of 139 suspects.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: The Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency reported that authorities confiscated illegal drugs valued at approximately ₱98 million and arrested 139 suspects during nationwide operations conducted from July 30 to August 6, 2026.
PDEA said the results came from 91 operations carried out during the week. The figures were reported by the Philippine News Agency on August 11.

sections.heading: What the figures mean
paragraphs: The seizure value is an official law-enforcement estimate. It should not be read as a court finding about the criminal liability of any person arrested.
Those arrested are suspects. They remain presumed innocent unless and until guilt is established through the judicial process.

sections.heading: Why it matters to Filipinos
paragraphs: Large multi-region operations affect public safety, criminal case handling and confidence in law enforcement. Transparent evidence inventories, lawful arrests and complete court proceedings are essential to establishing what happened in each case.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: The cases will proceed through evidence testing, inquest or preliminary investigation and, where charges are filed, court review. Final counts and case outcomes may differ from initial operational reports.
